critical_code_review_comments: BUG (FIXED): /app/backend/routers/audit.py - GET /audit response contained MongoDB ObjectIds nested inside old_values/new_values causing PydanticSerializationError. Root cause: callers (e.g. APE delete handler) snapshot the full Mongo document including _id ObjectId before serializing. Fixed by recursive _clean() at READ time that strips _id and stringifies ObjectIds.

/app/backend/services/audit.py log_audit accepts arbitrary Dict[str, Any] for old_values/new_values without validating that values are JSON-serializable. Recommend using bson.json_util.dumps(...).loads(...) round-trip OR explicit projection in callers to exclude _id.
/app/backend/routers/audit.py user enrich query uses projection {nome:1} which by default still returns _id (harmless because only nome is read, but inconsistent). Now fixed to {_id:0, nome:1}.

/app/frontend/src/pages/ProfiloPage.jsx: backend save works but no visible success toast/notification was detected after click. Either the toast library isn't called, or the toast text doesn't include common Italian success keywords. Verify implementation.

rca of the issue: Audit GET /audit 500: callers like routers/ape.py log delete with full Mongo doc as old_values; MongoDB docs from find() include _id (ObjectId). When stored in audit_log.old_values then retrieved and Pydantic-serialized, FastAPI fails because ObjectId has no JSON serializer. Reproduction: delete any APE then GET /api/v1/audit -> 500. Mitigation: recursive sanitize at GET time (DONE). Long-term: sanitize at WRITE time in services/audit.py.
